summary: SPK RC 53 sua trang Cai dat > Cap nhat va giup Package Center thay ban moi nhanh hon.
changes: Trang Cai dat > Cap nhat hien dung phien ban dang chay va ban moi nhat (truoc day hien 'unknown' / '-' va luon bao 'Dang la ban moi nhat'). Khi co ban moi, trang huong dan cap nhat trong DSM Package Center va hien san dia chi nguon goi de them vao Package Center.
Nguon goi /spkserver giu ban tin tu GitHub toi da 5 phut thay vi 15 phut, nen ban moi hien trong Package Center nhanh hon; neu GitHub tam loi van tra ve ban tin gan nhat thay vi danh sach rong.
